description: List, reply to, hide, or delete public comments on published Instagram posts and Threads replies (live Meta Graph API), or configure an automated viral Auto-Plug reply (`auto_plug`) that triggers when a post crosses a specified like threshold. Use this tool to engage commenters, remove spam on X/LinkedIn/Instagram/YouTube, or automatically plug a newsletter or product URL underneath high-performing posts. Returns moderation execution status or the active Auto-Plug rule configuration.

accountId.description: Connected account id (`acc_...`); defaults to the first live account of `platform`.

action.description: Comment moderation action on the connected Instagram (comments) or Threads (replies) account: 'list_posts' recent posts, 'list' comments on a post, 'reply' publicly to a comment, 'hide'/'unhide', 'delete' (Instagram only), or 'auto_plug' to attach an automatic threshold-triggered reply.

autoPlugMessage.description: Call-to-action comment text (e.g. link to docs, newsletter, or product page) automatically posted once the post reaches `autoPlugTriggerLikes`.

autoPlugTriggerLikes.description: Like count threshold (e.g. 25 or 50 likes) that triggers Nuntior to automatically publish `autoPlugMessage` as a follow-up comment.

commentId.description: Specific comment identifier (`cmt_...`) when replying to, hiding, or deleting an individual comment.

externalPostId.description: Platform media id (Instagram media id / Threads post id). Alternative to a Nuntior `postId`.

postId.description: Target social post identifier (`post_...`) whose comments are being listed, moderated, or configured for Auto-Plug.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) that owns the social post and comments.

replyText.description: Public reply message text when `action` is 'reply'.

name: comments_moderate
title: Moderate Comments & Viral Auto-Plug
